intro: The Offering Stone is a ritual altar hidden away in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest. Discovered through fragments of a weathered note, the stone is strewn with bizarre implements and items meant for an unknown offering. Investigating the site reveals active ritual preparations taking place in the shadowed wilderness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.
An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.
Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Strange implements and items litter the rough surface of the stone.
This is surely the offering stone that is mentioned in the note.
